signal_to_noise.rationale: No tests means no noise; per the scale, a no-tests app rates 3 here.

findings.issue: The app ships zero tests and no test tooling despite containing ~550 lines of data-transformation logic that only acceptance tests currently exercise.
findings.suggestion: Add a minimal vitest (or @tanstack/router + testing-library) setup and unit-test format.ts and the loaders' pure logic first; those tests cost minutes and cover the highest-risk code.

findings.issue: Home filtering (type/generation/search intersection), the 48-per-page pagination math and the page clamp (totalPages 0 → page 1) are untested; a refactor could double-count or off-by-one the page slice silently.
findings.suggestion: Extract filtering/paging into a pure function over species data and unit-test edge cases: empty results, last partial page, page beyond range, combined filters.

findings.issue: compareRows implements the subtle 'missing values sort last in both directions' rule plus the ascending/descending flip and aria-sort; none of it is tested.
findings.suggestion: Render MovesTable with rows including null power/accuracy and assert order and aria-sort after clicks — a direct behavioural test.

findings.issue: Move-table dedupe key (method|move|level), level-up ordering (level then name) and the level-up/machine/egg/tutor-then-alphabetical method ordering are untested; changing the dedupe key to omit level would duplicate rows unnoticed.
findings.suggestion: Unit-test the grouping/ordering with a small fixture of version_group_details covering duplicate entries and unordered methods.

findings.issue: latestEnglishFlavor's reverse-find (last English entry) and collapseWhitespace, plus englishEntry and idFromUrl regex, are untested pure functions where an off-by-one (first vs last entry) is easy to introduce.
findings.suggestion: Table-driven unit tests against fixture arrays with \f/\n and non-English entries; zero mocking needed.

findings.issue: URL search validation and the filter-change-resets-page-1 contract (page: undefined in updateSearch) are only covered by acceptance tests; a refactor of validateSearch could break deep links like /?type=fire&generation=generation-i.
findings.suggestion: Unit-test validateSearch directly and add one navigation test that changing a select resets page while preserving other filters.

findings.issue: The memo cache (TTL expiry, in-flight dedupe, unbounded Map) is untested; a stale-cache or never-expiring bug would surface as confusing 'wrong data' reports, not test failures.
findings.suggestion: Unit-test memo with fake timers for expiry and concurrent-load dedupe.

findings.issue: The #moves hash-scroll effect and ?game= preselection (api.server.ts:372-375, at(-1) default) are untested; effects with requestAnimationFrame timing regress easily.
findings.suggestion: A single Playwright-style test rendering the page with ?game=... asserting the select value and hash jump would pin both behaviours.

summary: The app contains no tests of its own — no runner, no script, no test files — leaving all filtering, pagination, sorting, URL-state and API-transformation logic guarded only by the external acceptance suite. The untested surface is large and exactly the kind (dedupe keys, missing-value sort order, form-exclusion filters, cache TTL) where refactoring bugs ship silently. A tiny vitest setup over the pure helpers and the sort comparator would have been cheap and high-yield; none was written.
